info.name: Microsoft Azure AccessControlClient AccessConnector Number API
Microsoft Azure Get Account Accountname Numbers

params.name: accountName
params.description: Name of the account. Can only contain letters, numbers, underscores and dashes, and is case-sensitive. Can be up to 100 characters in length.

params.name: api-version
params.description: Client API version

params.name: maxpagesize
params.description: Maximum number of records to include in a single response. Defaults to 200, and must not exceed 500.

params.name: skip
params.description: An offset into the collection of the first record to be returned.

items.docs: Gets a list of the numbers assigned to the specified account. Response pagination can be controlled with a combination of the maxpagesize and skip parameters. Limit the number of records in a response with the maxpagesize parameter. Specify the starting record using the skip parameter.
